title: "About"

This portfolio brings together my coursework for **ISS626 Visual Analytics and Applications**. The projects explore how spatial data, statistical methods and careful visualisation can support an evidence-based argument.

## How to read the projects

Each exercise presents the question, data preparation, analysis and interpretation. Expand the R code to inspect the method, use the interactive maps to explore locations, and download the figures where provided.

The learning reflections focus on what the results show, which choices matter and where the evidence stops. Source links and reproducibility instructions accompany the work.
